text_block_list.text: One day, as summer training camp reached its midpoint.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Nwaaaaaaaagh--!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You're really fired up, Ace.
...Though maybe I should be a little worried?
Mr. C.B. values her freedom and rarely interferes with others. If even she is worried, something truly serious must be going on.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I've been running non-stop lately!
Early mornings, late nights, you name it.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Even while eating or moving around, she had a barbell in one hand, with this wild look in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: That might just be how fired up she is for the Kikuka Sho, though!

And so, on the night of the day we had that talk,
while I was out on a walk, by coincidence—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Nn...
Huh, isn't that Ace?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Damn it... Not enough, not enough at all...!
At this rate, I'm just gonna repeat the same mistake!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Dammit... What am I supposed to do...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
choice_data_list: Mr. C.B., let's quietly head back...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: *cough*, *cough cough*!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry.
Turns out it's a summer cold.

Not only did I let her catch a cold, but
I didn't even notice at all. The color instantly drained from my face.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't worry about it, I brought it upon myself.
...Sleeping outside last night was probably a bad idea.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I think I'll get better soon if I just sleep.
It's not like I'm sickly or anything."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"And with that, I'm gonna hole up for a while.
Sorry for the trouble, Trainer.
Thanks for carrying everything, Ace."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it, it's nothing.
More importantly, go to sleep and get better soon!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yes.

Just as I wonder if I should head back to my room for a moment,
I feel Katsuragi Ace's gaze turning toward me.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...See, you were watching, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: At that distance, of course they'd hear it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: To be honest, it's kinda embarrassing, but whatever, it's fine now. More importantly—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
......
Hey, CB's Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"How do you think
I can surpass C.B.?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, not like there's any point in asking you, though...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "Still, I did everything I could! And even then, the results didn't follow...!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'm at such a loss...
that I'm practically hoping for charity from the enemy.

"Judging by the look of things,
she's definitely being backed into a corner."

In the first place, why is Katsuragi Ace
so fixated on Mr. C.B.?
choice_data_list: Why do you look up to CB?
Why do you look up to CB?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I suppose it's only right that I explain.
It's going to be a bit long, though. Is that okay?
With that, Katsuragi Ace began to speak bit by bit.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I'm from the middle of nowhere in the countryside...
We barely had any decent training facilities."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It was such a cramped place,
where the Twinkle Series felt like a completely different world.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Still, one day a traveling racing clinic came to town.
And I got to take part in it!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Entering the world of racing made me so incredibly happy...!
I was walking on air. For the first time in my life, I had a huge dream!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
So, when we got all pumped up and entered our first competition...
Those big-city elite Umamusume took one look at our team and told us this.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: They said, “As if a country bumpkin could ever win.”

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
And then, I got beaten to a pulp!
Everyone was saying, "Those girls were right."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's resigned to the idea that an Umamusume
from a podunk town without decent facilities could never win.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I firmly believed there was no reason to give up—
so seeing her just quit pissed me off so damn much...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
So, I made up my mind.
I'm gonna run in the Twinkle Series
and bloom into something spectacular!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: If an Umamusume who came out of the countryside with nothing to her name could become a brilliant "ace"—!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "You can prove them wrong! You can show everyone, like, 'See? Pedigree doesn't mean a thing!'"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...And while chasing that dream,
there happened to be someone who was the perfect role model."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: That is—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! That girl is extraordinary.
She leaves common sense in the dust!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
That's why I thought if I could surpass C.B.,
I'd become a true "Ace"!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ......Though.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...When I actually ran, there wasn't a single moment where I felt like I had surpassed it. On top of that—

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: —I'm seriously going to surpass C.B.!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Shining on the turf, breaking all conventions...
CB was the very image of the "Ace" I had always envisioned.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, it's super frustrating.
But just being frustrated isn't enough
to catch up, is it?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Geez, what on earth am I supposed to do—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ace.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Ngh! CB!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"The walls are thin, y'know. They can hear you.
More importantly—hey."

Mr. C.B. muttered, her tone tinged
with a faint edge of anger.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'm Mr. C.B.
And you're Katsuragi Ace.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
We're nothing more and nothing less to each other.
Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: That's my answer to you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
*cough*...
Well then, I'm going back to sleep for a bit...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: H-Hey, C.B....!

In the end, Katsuragi Ace left the scene
looking lost in thought.
—A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Alright, fully recovered!
Well then, shall we begin? Intensive training!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yep! Just decided this morning. By the way, the proposal's already all planned out right up in my head.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
There are two patterns. As for the regimen,
I'll leave that up to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Between the "Summer Beach Muscle Training Menu"
and "Surpass Your Limits, Triathlon!",
which one do you think is better?

Though taken aback by the sudden surge of motivation,
I went ahead and made a choice for now.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, understood.
Let's train hard and build ourselves up.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
By the way, this is the kind of muscle training I want to do.
But I'd like to hear your thoughts too.
Looking over the list handed to me, it was filled with an intense, grueling lineup of muscle training routines that showed serious dedication.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to change the intensity if possible.
I just want to get through it as effectively as I can.

Keeping the intensity virtually unchanged,
I carefully refined the muscle training menu and commenced training...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...*pheeew*...!
Ow-ow-ow... That was seriously brutal.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
But... yeah.
I know we've definitely gotten stronger.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, let's do our best in the Kikuka Sho.
Let's beat Ace.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
A triathlon, huh?
Those are pretty fun, so I actually kinda like them.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's get ready.
First—

And so, based on Mr. C.B.'s suggestions,
I arranged the course and equipment—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'm off!
(Splash!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Whew! It just rolls all on its own!
Riding a bike downhill is so much fun!
Mr. C.B., having trained and forged herself by truly running with all her might.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ah... I can't move anymore...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks.
...Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...I really want to do my best in the Kikuka Sho.
I want to beat Ace.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Let's win, without fail.

She cast a sharp gaze toward Katsuragi Ace.
Though she didn't voice her thoughts,
there was unmistakably a burning fire hidden within.

And so, the days of training harder than ever
for the Kikuka Sho continued on.
